elements.name: Alert
elements.doc: A modal alert with the Stop / Note / Caution icon: severity: .stop | .note | .caution; buttons:, primary:

elements.name: AppleMenu
elements.doc: The Apple menu at the left of the menu bar (a neutral rainbow glyph); open: true shows its items

elements.name: ApplicationMenu
elements.doc: The Application menu at the right of the menu bar: icon and name of the frontmost application

elements.name: Balloon
elements.doc: Balloon help: Balloon("Click to empty the Trash.") { target view }; placement:

elements.name: BevelButton
elements.doc: A square bevel button (toolbar-style); icon:, .selected() for the pressed state

elements.name: Button
elements.doc: A Platinum push button. .variant(.default) (or DefaultButton) draws the default ring

elements.name: CheckBox
elements.doc: A Platinum check box; checked: true | .mixed

elements.name: ControlPanel
elements.doc: A control panel window (platinum body); combine with Tabs, GroupBox, PopupMenu …

elements.name: ControlStrip
elements.doc: The Control Strip: ControlStripModule children; place at the bottom-left of the Desktop

elements.name: ControlStripModule
elements.doc: One Control Strip module (icon + popup arrow)

elements.name: DefaultButton
elements.doc: The default push button with its thick outline (Return activates it)

elements.name: Desktop
elements.doc: The Finder desktop (pattern background). Put a MenuBar first, then place windows and icons with .position(x:y:)

elements.name: Dialog
elements.doc: A centred modal dialog (Mac OS 9 has no sheets)

elements.name: DisclosureTriangle
elements.doc: A disclosure triangle with its label; expanded: true shows the content

elements.name: Finder
elements.doc: A Finder window; put an InfoBar, then FinderIcon/Folder… (icon view) or a FinderList (list view) inside

elements.name: FinderIcon
elements.doc: A Finder / desktop icon with its name below. icon: any icon name; .selected() inverts the name

elements.name: FinderList
elements.doc: Finder list view: columns: ["Name", "Date Modified", "Size", "Kind"], rows:, sortColumn:, selectedRows:

elements.name: FloatingWindow
elements.doc: A floating palette / utility window with a thin title bar

elements.name: GroupBox
elements.doc: A primary group box (etched frame, title on the frame)

elements.name: InfoBar
elements.doc: The Finder window header: InfoBar("12 items", "1.2 GB available")

elements.name: ListView
elements.doc: A list box (white, inset frame); Row/ListItem children, .selected() highlights

elements.name: LittleArrows
elements.doc: The little up/down arrows control beside a number field

elements.name: MenuBar
elements.doc: The menu bar: AppleMenu(), Menu("File") …, Spacer(), Text(clock), ApplicationMenu("Finder")

elements.name: MenuItem
elements.doc: A menu item. shortcut: "⌘N", checked:, .disabled(), .highlighted() (the item under the pointer)

elements.name: MenuTitle
elements.doc: A menu bar title; MenuTitle("File", open: true) { MenuItem(…) } shows its menu

elements.name: ModalDialog
elements.doc: A modal dialog drawn in place (no title bar); use Dialog for a centred overlay

elements.name: MovableModalDialog
elements.doc: A movable modal dialog: title bar without close box

elements.name: PopupMenu
elements.doc: A popup menu button with the double arrow; PopupMenu("Font:", items: […], selection:, open:)

elements.name: ProgressBar
elements.doc: A progress bar; value: 0…1, or no value for the (static) blue barber pole

elements.name: PullDownMenu
elements.doc: A pull-down menu (menu bar title or bevel button menu)

elements.name: ScrollArea
elements.doc: A scrolling content area with Platinum scroll bars (arrows together at the bottom / right)

elements.name: SecondaryGroupBox
elements.doc: A secondary group box (lighter etched frame)

elements.name: Slider
elements.doc: A Platinum slider with the pointed thumb; Slider("Volume:", value: 0.4, ticks: 5)

elements.name: TabControl
elements.sample: TabControl(["One", "Two", "Three"]) { Text("First tab").tabItem { Text("One") }; Text("Second tab").tabItem { Text("Two") } }

elements.name: Tabs
elements.doc: Platinum tab control (as in the Appearance control panel); Tab("Fonts") { … } children
elements.sample: Tabs(["One", "Two", "Three"]) { Text("First tab").tabItem { Text("One") }; Text("Second tab").tabItem { Text("Two") } }

elements.name: TextField
elements.doc: An edit-text field with the inset frame; .state(.focused) draws the focus ring

elements.name: Toolbar
elements.doc: A window toolbar of BevelButtons (application-drawn, platinum)

elements.name: Window
elements.doc: A Platinum window: striped title bar, close box, zoom and collapse boxes. .inactive() greys the title bar

elements.name: Canvas
elements.doc: free-form area; place children with .position(x:y:); grid: .dots|.lines

elements.name: Grid
elements.doc: Grid of GridRow children, or columns: n

elements.name: KanbanCard
elements.doc: title, description:, tags: [..], assignees: [..], due:, comments:, priority:

elements.name: MessageBubble
elements.doc: MessageBubble("Hi", from: .me|.them, author:, time:, status:, reactions: [..])

elements.name: Placeholder
elements.doc: A labelled box for maps, charts, media

elements.name: SelectionRect
elements.doc: a drag-selection rectangle; size with .frame, place with .position

elements.name: Spreadsheet
elements.doc: rows: [[…]], selection: "B2:C4", active:, formula:, sheets: [..], highlight: ["B3": .yellow]

elements.name: TabView
elements.sample: TabView() { Text("First tab").tabItem { Text("One") }; Text("Second tab").tabItem { Text("Two") } }

elements.name: TreeItem
elements.doc: label, systemImage:, folder:, expanded:, selected:, detail:

elements.name: VideoPlayer
elements.doc: poster image, progress: 0…1, time:, duration:, playing:
